description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ Type-0 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Engineer], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Heavy Debuff Shot Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Engineer
description.text: Unlimited Machinist hones, Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Heavy Debuff Shot Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Heavy Debuff Shot after using three Machinist abilities
